llm.summary: This skill appears to do what it claims, but it enables sensitive employment filtering and mandatory tracked agency links without enough user safeguards.

dimensions.detail: The local Node script uses no third-party dependencies and only builds a request to `https://www.sunriselink.sg/api/public/v1/helpers`, which is proportionate for a database search skill. The tool still sends user-selected hiring filters to the agency API.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The documented install command uses unpinned `npx skills add` against a mutable GitHub repository URL. No malicious dependency was observed in the inspected artifact, but the install path does not guarantee the reviewed content is what later users install.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are mostly task-focused, but they direct the agent to solicit sensitive preferences by default and to always append a UTM-tracked Sunrise Link promotional link after results or no-result responses.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, credential access, background workers, privilege escalation, local indexing, or file mutation behavior was found in the inspected files.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is coherent: search Sunrise Link domestic-helper candidates through a fixed public API. However, the skill explicitly asks for and filters on nationality, religion, language, and age in an employment-matching context, and presents religion and marital status in results without responsible-use or anti-discrimination guardrails.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill carefully before installing. It queries an agency database and can filter domestic-helper candidates by sensitive attributes such as nationality, religion, and age; use only lawful, job-related criteria and avoid discriminatory screening. Be aware that responses are instructed to include tracked Sunrise Link URLs, and prefer installing from a pinned, verified commit or release rather than the mutable `npx` command shown.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: Filtering candidate profiles is central to the skill, but the artifact-backed concern is valid because it includes sensitive employment attributes such as nationality, religion, and age without clear compliance, fairness, or minimization guidance.
[RP1] unexpected: The unpinned `npx skills add` installer and mutable repository reference are real supply-chain weaknesses, but they are install hygiene concerns rather than evidence that the reviewed skill itself is malicious.
[LP3] expected: A local Node search tool is expected for the stated purpose. The inspected script is narrowly coded to one Sunrise Link endpoint, so this is downgraded to a scoping note rather than an independent verdict driver.
[T01] expected: Providing Sunrise Link profile or agency links fits the commercial search purpose, but the unconditional UTM-tracked link requirement is under-disclosed promotional tracking and contributes to the Review verdict.
[T08] unexpected: The mutable install command is confirmed in the artifact. No insecure runtime dependency was found; the concern is that future installs may fetch unreviewed installer or repository content.
